answer: Every claim climbs the terrace of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sparrow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
